sloka: प्रजापतिः पुरा सृष्ट्वा ह्यपः सलिलसम्भवः ।तासां गोपायने सत्त्वानसृजत्पद्मसम्भवः ।। ७.४.९ ॥
transliteration: prajāpatiḥ purā sṛṣṭvā hyapaḥ salilasambhavaḥ ।tāsāṁ gopāyane sattvānasṛjatpadmasambhavaḥ ।। 7.4.9 ॥

translations.english: In ancient times, Prajapati Brahma, who was born from water and a lotus, first created the waters and then created various beings for their protection.
